done_when: forge close opens a blocked pull request as a draft and marks it ready for review once its review is clean and its checks are green

findings.body: The new draft-to-ready test only supplies green checks. The red, pending, missing-check and API-error cases in tests/test_close.py:221–248 use the default empty PR list and never assert that promotion is withheld. Consequently, promoting a draft from a finally block around checks.wait would pass both the new ordering assertion and the existing refusal tests while marking failed-check PRs ready. Extend those cases with an existing draft and assert that no `pr ready` command is issued, then verify promotion after a successful retry. This covers the negative half of the explicit green-check requirement.
findings.title: Not done: a draft stays draft when required checks are not green

why: A pull request whose review is still blocked looks mergeable on GitHub
